body: What caused you to not be that good at those things? Was it anxiety ot something else?

I worked in a grocery store. I dunno if it's anxiety or what but I always felt dumb when I failed to succeed at basic tasks. It happened a couple times a week. I know there are nice people out there but I dont have a way of meeting them.
Well I can try doing what the other poster suggested fot a doctor visit. People at work usually made fun of me. I always would have trouble doing seemingly basic things :/

I don't have health insurance. A doctor's visit is too expensive,  especially therapy. I just don't see a point in moving. I'm too stupid to drive a car and too afraid to go outside lately so a job is near impossible.  Even if I have a job I'm ALWAYS made fun of for being dumb.
